title: Be aware!
text: Be aware!. This product really only works with the two cup like devices provided. I learned the hard way that you cannot use the blender or mixer alone in a bowl. Its sprayed my batter all over my kitchen wall! I am still finding the spray today half way across the kitchen! I've never been so mad. There is no "slow" setting despite the claim you can adjust it. This is meant for super mixing it seems just drinks despite it's claim. I have deep baking bowls and this still sprays batter out no matter how I tried to adjust it. I even tried the other "blender" just to see if it might work. It does not, it is designed to emulsify fruits and veggies, etc. So no, this is not just a hand mixer as I thought it might be used for as well. Good grief!
